mapper.select: select supplier_shop_id, shop_name, shop_settlement_cycle, shop_settlement_last_time from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where shop_status = 3 and shop_type in (1, 3)
select supplier_shop_id, shop_name from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where shop_status = 3 and shop_type = 1
select supplier_shop_id, shop_name from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where shop_status = 3 and shop_type = 2

select sb.supplier_shop_id, sb.shop_name, sb.shop_settlement_cycle, sb.shop_settlement_last_time from (select shop_id from ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_gate group by shop_id) sg left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = sg.shop_id where sb.shop_status = 3 and sb.shop_type in (1, 3)
select supplier_shop_id as shop_id, shop_name, shop_settlement_cycle, shop_settlement_last_time from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where shop_status = 3 and shop_type = 2
